summary: Both targets promoted to full records. Ep 3 'The New King' ends at chapter 17 with start 14: MAL episode-3 discussion states the anime was 'approximately 17 chapters in 3 episodes' and, explicitly, that the post-ep-3 continue point is 'chapter 18, where Bojji starts his journey' (= ep 4 'His First Journey'); the episode opens by finishing the linearized succession block (chs 9-10 announcement/vote + ch 13 tail: Bebin relaying Kage's 'long journey' message), verified against fandom chapter summaries for chs 8-13. Ep 19 'The Last Bastion' = chapters 118-130 (all of volume 10): bracketed by the batch-11 verified exact anchors ep18 end=117 (= v9's last chapter, fandom Volume 9 page) and ep20 start=131 (= v11's first), and independently matched by Volume 10's blurb ('Bojji struggles alone against immortal Ouken... Kage tries to lend a hand... the kingdom finally unites') which is precisely ep 19's content; the episode ends with the Daida/Bosse revival teeing up ep 20 ('Can We Trust King Bosse?'). Zone bounds firmed: ep 18's flashback material is its own mainline ~110-117 (v9 blurb: 'the sinful past of Bosse and Miranjo is revealed'), while ep 19 grafts early-v11 beats (~131-134: adventurer Bosse finds and raises the destroyed young Miranjo, per Volume 11 blurb + In Asian Spaces ep-19 screenshots), and the devil-deal backstory beat surfaces in ep 20 (sportskeeda ep-20 recap). No repairs; stored anchors all held.

anchors.note: Opens by finishing the linearized deathbed/succession block: Daida announced king (ch 9), vote reveal (ch 10, referenced when Daida orders Bebin to kill Apeas/Sorii for not voting for him), and Bebin's 'long journey' message to Bojji (ch 13's final scene); bulk is new mainline 14-17 (Apeas vs Bebin, dungeon/Mitsumata, Hilling permits the journey), so start=14 by majority rule. End=17 from MAL thread ('~17 chapters in 3 episodes'; 'scanlation only up to ch 17 and the anime is already ahead'; continue point 'chapter 18, where Bojji starts his journey'), consistent with ep2 end=13 and ep4 'His First Journey'. Ch 17 is in v2 (chs 14-27).
